detail.longDescription: NVIDIA Cloud Functions (#NVCF) is NVIDIA’s platform for running GPU workloads as functions. You package an inference model, and NVCF routes requests to GPU workers that can serve it. NVIDIA’s self-managed edition brings the same platform to your own # Kubernetes clusters, and NVCF Release 1.0.1 ships with a single-node VictoriaMetrics chart as the default for # metrics storage.
